title.en: FDA Approves First Treatment for Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Type 2I/R9

summary.en: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved the first medicine for treating limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9 (LGMD2I/R9), a rare inherited muscle disease, for adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 30 kg.

title.en: FDA Approves First New Hormone Therapy for Early-Stage Breast Cancer in More Than 20 Years

summary.en: The FDA today approved Wilserdly (giredestrant), used alone after surgery in adults with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative breast cancer — the most common subtype of the disease.

title.en: FDA Approves First Drug to Treat Neurological Symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher Disease

summary.en: FDA today approved Infilbray (venglustat) tablets, the first treatment for the neurological symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher disease (GD3) in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 15 kg (approximately 33 pounds).

title.en: FDA Launches the Global Reliance Disclosure Program to Expand Patient Access to Medicines Worldwide

summary.en: FDA today announced the Global Reliance Disclosure Program (GRDP), a landmark initiative that will fundamentally transform how the FDA's regulatory drug and biologic approval decisions are leveraged by health authorities around the world.

title.en: FDA Approves First Drug Shown to Help Patients with Infantile-Onset Niemann-Pick Disease Type C Live Longer

summary.en: FDA approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) injection, the first treatment shown to help people with a severe form of Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC) live longer.
